user.description: The system user account to switch to after startup. Needs USB privileges.

disable_hotplug.description: If true, disables automatic discovery of devices on hotplug.

enable_exit.description: If true, enables '--exit' request from other instances and exit automatically if no device is attached.

run_udev_mode.description: If true, runs in udev operation mode (implies disable-hotplug and enable-exit).

run_systemd_mode.description: If true, runs in systemd operation mode (implies enable-exit and foreground).
